name: stefs-plugins
description: Stef's Claude Code plugins — the portable layer of software and project architecture conventions, the documentation and planning conventions that sit beside them, plus general-purpose utilities.

plugins.name: arc-conventions
plugins.description: Seven skills carrying the portable layer of a project's software and project architecture conventions: HTTP/JSON API design (payloads, list endpoints, errors, versioning), SPA frontends, Terraform/AWS infrastructure, Go and Node Lambdas, MySQL, and product requirements. How a project records its own conventions, and the documentation, proposal, plan-of-action and glossary rules, are in the sibling documentation-and-planning plugin. Every skill is model-invoked on topic match; the plugin registers no hooks and adds no executable code.

plugins.name: documentation-and-planning
plugins.description: Four skills carrying the portable layer of documentation and planning conventions: conventions (how a project records its own rules in conventions/, the two-layer model, and precedence), documentation (the markdown rules every document follows, including an up-to-date table of contents; the three tenses of architecture/, instructions/ and proposals/; API docs, READMEs, diagrams and writing proposals), plan-of-action (the staged implementation plan a settled proposal becomes, and carrying it out stage by stage), and glossary (one file per term, linked rather than restated). Model-invoked on topic match; the plugin registers no hooks and adds no executable code.

plugins.name: utils
plugins.description: General-purpose utility commands, skills and agents for Claude Code, including the default-on auto-summary-commit workflow: a pair of hooks commits the prompt and its summary at the end of every turn that changed files, scoped to the paths that turn actually changed.
